constraints.name: Asset_storage_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((data IS NOT NULL) <> ("blobId" IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: Metric_weekly_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((period <> 'WEEKLY'::text) OR ((platform = ANY (ARRAY['TIKTOK'::text, 'INSTAGRAM'::text, 'FACEBOOK'::text, 'YOUTUBE'::text, 'WHATSAPP'::text, 'OTRO'::text])) AND (EXTRACT(isodow FROM date) = (1)::numeric) AND ((date)::time without time zone = '12:00:00'::time without time zone) AND (views >= 0) AND (likes >= 0) AND (comments >= 0) AND (shares >= 0) AND (saves >= 0) AND (reach >= 0) AND (clicks >= 0) AND (leads >= 0) AND (orders >= 0) AND (((spend)::double precision >= (0)::double precision) AND ((spend)::double precision <= ('1000000000000'::numeric)::double precision)) AND (((revenue)::double precision >= (0)::double precision) AND ((revenue)::double precision <= ('1000000000000'::numeric)::double precision)) AND (("watchTimeSec" >= (0)::double precision) AND ("watchTimeSec" <= ('1000000000000'::numeric)::double precision)) AND ((retention3s IS NULL) OR ((retention3s >= (0)::double precision) AND (retention3s <= (100)::double precision))))))
